decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication line is close to the core offer for machine-tool users and serves demand for less coolant use, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspiration and with modular platforms keeping its cost low, there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The hydrocyclone filter builds on the established filtration platform and shares resources with the core business, so management has little reason to drop it while results remain uncertain and slack from the broad product range can carry it.

Gravity band coolant filters are a standard part of the firm's one-stop filtration offer with low incremental cost, so keeping the product fits the aspiration of complete-system delivery and no performance gap is reported.
